channel.title: Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily tech opinions digest for Yun Zhou

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: AI #193 — Progress May Dramatically Accelerate
item.description: Anthropic's amended S-1 says it may imminently meet its own definition of 'dramatically accelerated progress attributable to AI' — plus the $5.6B Binance hack, GLM-5.3 autonomously compromising Firefox, and LLMs that read and edit raw model weights.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: Without CDA 230, Facebook will own the internet forever
item.description: Repealing Section 230 wouldn't hurt Big Tech — it would wipe out small volunteer-run communities, as a libel suit nearly did to one Doctorow helped found 30 years ago.

item.title: Jessica Hullman: Verification Is Not Knowledge — Science needs more than answers
item.description: AI can verify proofs and produce answers, but science needs human understanding and accountability to turn verified results into knowledge — a direct reply to Terry Tao's thought experiment.
